note: Selected reference realisations and therefore all correct/spurious/missed marks are read from the frozen scorer's preserved held-out report, not recomputed by this script.
alternative_semantics: Each requirement has one or more acceptable document routes. A valid realization selects exactly one route per requirement; documents beyond the selected realization are spurious.
vocabulary: +Expert's valuation of the scheduled valuable (Wertgutachten eines Sachverstaendigen / Schaetzung)
+Receipt for the scheduled valuable (Quittung / Rechnung)
-Completed double-insurance declaration listing, per category, the other insurance company and policy number; the form marks this section as to be completed in every case
-Payment instruction with payee name and address, IBAN and name of the financial institution
-Separate itemised list of the stolen or damaged objects, where the form's table is insufficient (the form's own 'Gemaess separater Liste' option)
+Completed and signed claim notification form (Schadenanzeige Hausrat / Gebaeude), submitted in full to the address on its last page or through the insurer's online channel
-Written claim notification in any form permitting proof by text (letter, e-mail, the insurer's online loss form), where the insurer has not required its own form
-Completed and signed claim notification form (Schadenanzeige Hausrat / Gebaeude), submitted in full to the address on its last page or through the insurer's online channel
+Separate itemised list of the stolen or damaged objects, where the form's table is insufficient (the form's own 'Gemaess separater Liste' option)
+Bicycle purchase voucher (Kaufbeleg des Fahrrads / Originalkaufbeleg)
+Detailed cost estimate for the bicycle with an image of the damaged or stolen bicycle or part (Detaillierter Kostenvoranschlag mit Foto)
+Written claim notification in any form permitting proof by text (letter, e-mail, the insurer's online loss form), where the insurer has not required its own form
+Report of the SIM-card theft to the insurer or to the mobile provider within 24 hours
+Bank statement showing the misuse, together with a police report or an equivalent document, where card data were misused after the theft
+Completed double-insurance declaration listing, per category, the other insurance company and policy number; the form marks this section as to be completed in every case
+Payment instruction with payee name and address, IBAN and name of the financial institution
+Completed claim-form section identifying the person who caused the loss and his liability insurer (name, address, insurance company, Policen-Nr. / Schaden-Nr.)
+Written assignment to the insurer of the claims against third parties up to the amount of the benefits rendered, with the evidence needed to pursue them
-Original purchase vouchers for the affected items (Originalbelege / Originalkaufbelege), including vouchers for the effective costs claimed under the insured cost heads
-Police report on the theft (Polizeirapport / Polizeibeleg), which the insurer may call for, evidencing the person who laid the report, the date of the report, the police station and the officer

-Signed valued inventory of the items present before and after the event and of the items affected (unterzeichnetes Verzeichnis mit Wertangaben), produced within any reasonable period the insurer sets
+Written appointment of a Sachverstaendiger by each party, and the appointment of an umpire before determination begins
+Insurer's written demand for the communications, under warning of the consequences of default, setting the period (10 days in the Generali wording)
+The experts' findings (Feststellungen der Sachverstaendigen), with the umpire's decision on points left in dispute
-Witness names and addresses (Namen und Adressen von allfaelligen Zeugen)
+Insurer's prior consent to a repair whose expected cost exceeds the consent threshold
+Insurer's consent to alteration of the damaged items before the loss is determined
+Police consent to the removal or alteration of the Tatspuren
+Written substantiation of the claim for indemnity, where the insurer demands it (schriftliche Begruendung des Entschaedigungsanspruchs)
+Report to the insurer that stolen items have been recovered or news of them received
+Insurer's declination of the claim for indemnity
